title: /run/meridian/update-status.json — PRD 8.0 contract (provider WP-04, consumer WP-12)
description: bootc is daemonless and offers no D-Bus API, so this file IS the interface between the update machinery and the Settings Updates page. It is committed as a schema so WP-12 can be built and tested against it before either side is finished, and so a change to the shape is a change someone has to review.

state.description: The headline. 'rolled-back' outranks the others: a machine that healed itself must say so even if an update is also staged, because that is the one state the user is owed an explanation for.

lastCheck.description: ISO 8601. When the check ran, not when an update was found — 'we looked and there was nothing' is information a user wants.

firmwareOffers.description: OFFERS. ADR-008: firmware is never auto-applied.
